source.author: Anastasia Kireeva
source.title: Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdős–Rényi graph (problems 36-38)

methods.summary: Derived margin-refined full-tail damping ||S_t Pi_{>=K}|| <= exp[-K alpha_t(s)-delta_s beta_t(s)], proved alpha_t(s)=s(1-exp(-kappa t/s)) is strictly increasing in admissible tilt, and reduced finite-K optimization to one scalar objective using local-table delta_s.

Showed unweighted tail pressure is exponentially equivalent to global chi-square under bounded source LDA, so that naive weakening fails. Replaced it by discounted degree pressure Theta_{r,D}=log(1+sum_{k>D}e^{-2rk}||Pi_k h||_2^2), proving same-degree noisy LDA and TV transfer for r below the aligned damping rate. Derived a substantive forced violation for Mao.

Identified Hsieh symmetry-quotient/truncation and Chen-Li positive-weight low-interface reassembly as two model-specific methods for controlling noise-discounted high-degree likelihood-ratio energy without assuming small unweighted global chi-square.

new_claims: Margin-refined tilted damping with explicit beta_t(s) bonus.
Optimal asymptotic degree damping uses the largest admissible tilt; alpha_t'(s)>0.
Discounted degree-pressure same-degree transfer theorem with geometric Cauchy factor.
Under bounded source LDA, raw unweighted tail pressure is not a genuine weakening of global chi-square.
Mao's perfectly aligned product-noise counterexample must violate discounted pressure at linear-in-D scale for every discount below the noise damping rate.
next_attack: Recast discounted degree pressure as an analytic degree generating function, derive a two-color polymer/reassembly certificate for that weighted generating function, and instantiate a genuinely nonproduct bounded-arity model where the discounted criterion succeeds beyond the prior unweighted pressure theorem.
